title: 氧化鎵功率元件研究
summary: 從材料潛力與實現、橫向與垂直到研究成熟度：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Material potential versus realization and Lateral versus vertical to Research maturity: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 材料潛力與實現 → 塊材與磊晶
stages.titleEn: Material potential versus realization to Bulk and epitaxy
stages.description: 把「材料潛力與實現」「晶相與方向」「塊材與磊晶」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Material potential versus realization, Phase and orientation, Bulk and epitaxy.

steps.title: 材料潛力與實現：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Material potential versus realization: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「理想優值不等於實際元件效率」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: An ideal figure of merit is not actual efficiency.
steps.instruction: 將理想材料優值與實測元件指標分為兩張表。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Separate ideal material figures of merit from measured device metrics. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 理想優值不等於實際元件效率；材料優值常假定理想漂移區。
steps.observationEn: An ideal figure of merit is not actual efficiency; Material figures often assume ideal drift regions.
steps.failure: 若採用「把理論材料排名當成產品能效排名」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Ranking product efficiency by ideal materials alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「材料潛力與實現」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：理想優值不等於實際元件效率。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Material potential versus realization diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: An ideal figure of merit is not actual efficiency.

knowledge.title: 材料潛力與實現／物理與模型
knowledge.titleEn: Material potential versus realization / Physics and model
knowledge.text: 機制：理想優值不等於實際元件效率。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: An ideal figure of merit is not actual efficiency.

knowledge.title: 材料潛力與實現／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Material potential versus realization / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「把理論材料排名當成產品能效排名」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Ranking product efficiency by ideal materials alone.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「氧化鎵功率元件研究」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「材料潛力與實現：建立模型」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：高臨界場材料潛力不等於已解決導熱與元件可靠度。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「特殊元件工坊：功率、光電與 MEMS」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：氧化鎵功率元件研究 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「高臨界場材料潛力不等於已解決導熱與元件可靠度」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use Gallium-oxide power-device research as the task boundary. After reading “Material potential versus realization: construct and analyze”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: High critical-field material potential does not resolve thermal transport or device reliability. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Special-device workshop: power, optoelectronics and MEMS”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for Gallium-oxide power-device research: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “High critical-field material potential does not resolve thermal transport or device reliability” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 關於「材料潛力與實現」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Material potential versus realization, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 理想優值不等於實際元件效率
把理論材料排名當成產品能效排名
以一個方向的數值代表所有方向
optionsEn: An ideal figure of merit is not actual efficiency
Ranking product efficiency by ideal materials alone
Using one directional value for every orientation
quiz.explanation: 理想優值不等於實際元件效率；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: An ideal figure of merit is not actual efficiency. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 材料潛力與實現：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Material potential versus realization: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「把理論材料排名當成產品能效排名」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Ranking product efficiency by ideal materials alone.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「材料潛力與實現」成果，先指出錯誤主張「把理論材料排名當成產品能效排名」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：材料優值常假定理想漂移區。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Material potential versus realization artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Ranking product efficiency by ideal materials alone". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Material figures often assume ideal drift regions. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 理想優值不等於實際元件效率；材料優值常假定理想漂移區。
steps.observationEn: An ideal figure of merit is not actual efficiency; Material figures often assume ideal drift regions.
steps.failure: 若採用「把理論材料排名當成產品能效排名」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Ranking product efficiency by ideal materials alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「材料潛力與實現」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「材料優值常假定理想漂移區」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Material potential versus realization, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Material figures often assume ideal drift regions" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 材料潛力與實現／物理與模型

knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Material figures often assume ideal drift regions.

knowledge.title: 材料潛力與實現／驗證與限制
